name: POS-CAFE
description: Cafe POS — modular point-of-sale platform built on the generic ERP kernel (Phases 0–7: kernel + finance + accounting + inventory + invoicing + receipts/payments + expenses/procurement + reporting + cash sessions). Cafe vertical: P3 receipts, P4 modifiers/combos, P5 KDS, P6 hardware, P7 loyalty/credit/tabs, P9 stock policy, P11 offline, Digital Menu.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint:arch && pnpm shared:build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @erp/api test
scripts.test:academics: pnpm --filter @erp/api exec jest test/unit/academic-fsm.spec.ts test/unit/marks-workspace.spec.ts test/unit/enrollment-grouping.spec.ts test/unit/course-offering-phase2.spec.ts test/integration/academics-foundation.spec.ts test/integration/school-enrollment-placement.spec.ts test/integration/school-assessment-core.spec.ts test/integration/school-assessment-roster.spec.ts test/integration/school-assessment-unified.spec.ts test/integration/school-gradeentry-parity.spec.ts test/integration/school-result-integrity.spec.ts --runInBand --detectOpenHandles
